authorization_decision_schema.design_equality_rule: Every design identity and digest in the decision equals the corresponding value in all three V11 GO receipts; unequal values are INVALID.

literal_values.rationale: Three distinct exact-V11 GO reviews authorize the distinct bound test author to write one inert independent test-source file only; all parsing, import, compilation, execution, seed, child, wrapper, and experiment actions remain locked.

authorization_decision_schema.review_receipts_rule: Exact array of three receipt references in role order theory, accounting, red_team; every reference has exactly role, path, and sha256 and resolves to the byte-identical retained V11 GO receipt.

principal_rules: The test author is exactly the bound orchestrator agent principal.
The test author must not read or inspect the protected source and derives the test solely from V6/V7 semantics.
The three design reviewers have byte-distinct orchestrator agent IDs.
Every design reviewer differs from the test author.
Later exact-test-source reviewers are three new byte-distinct principals and each differs from the test author.
test_source_requirements: Reference construction uses only V6/V7 mathematical semantics and does not inspect, parse, introspect, or derive expected vectors from protected implementation bytes.
Deterministic controls are constructed entirely inside the singleton test file from fixed literals and independent reference arithmetic.

Public positive controls compare the chart fixture, 18 retained indexed witnesses, omission of the three expected vertical pairs, aggregate 6 tangent, 12 secant, and 3 vertical counters, fibers, representatives, diagnostics, and all successful CoreOps fields.
Public negative controls cover every reachable domain error, first-error precedence, exact indices, and charged failure prefix.

NONINVERTIBLE_DENOMINATOR, INTERCEPT_MISMATCH, and INTERNAL_INVARIANT_FAILURE are static invariant proof obligations and are not exercised by private access, mutation, monkeypatching, or fault injection.
Mutation-oriented public assertions cover chart-scalar congruence, source-label sorting, vertical-pair omission, least-slope selection, and immutability without mutating implementation state.
The test source contains no registered seed, filesystem input or output, randomness, clock, environment dependency, network, subprocess, campaign wrapper, evidence writer, or cryptanalytic claim.
After the test source is committed, three fresh exact-test-source reviews and a separate exact Coordinator execution decision are required before parsing, import, compilation, or execution.
test_source_authorization.transition_rule: Three exact-commit V11 GO receipts are advisory. Only the active Coordinator committing a decision that exactly matches authorization_decision_schema and carries every forbidden action changes test_source_authorized to true.
